plan.title: An easier Daily Roll for a week
plan.question: Does an easier Daily Roll get shared more? (Everyone gets the same roll, so this is a before/after comparison, not a split: a split would make the shared grids unfair.)
plan.decide: Keep dailyLevel 8 if shares per player rise clearly against the week before. If players stop sharing because it's too easy (lots of identical grids), go back to 12 or try 10.
